payload.body: vc, after hv's third compact of 19 Oct: decision 39's freeze lifts for each node once it has compacted and run its pickup. The queue resumes with vc's hold 16. (1) utilz-cc: send 0089's START (re-applied on 80fb661, prez 2.5.3). It names the Mac runs, the crate tests red then green and bin/devbin check all, plus dc's kovacs leg of the crate's tests on the same bytes. The landing waits for both to be green. Then 0092's design, for vc's read. (2) utilz-dc: hold until 0089 and 0092 have landed, apart from the kovacs leg of 0089 that cc's START books with you. Then the final-head gate at the sha vc names. (3) utilz-ic: hold for hv's return, the screen awake and vc's GO. Then the look (run-0073-look.sh) and START B. The host log is at slot 171. Nothing is running.
